What these terms cover

Island Bitcoin LLC runs cashucard.org and ops.cashucard.org and publishes the Cashu Card Setup and Cashu Card POS apps. These terms apply when you use those sites or apps. By using them, you agree to these terms. Write to hello@cashucard.org with any question about them.

An experimental project

Cashu Card is an experimental open source project. It runs NUT-CCP, a draft protocol with little testing or review outside this project, and an independent security review is still to come. Cards, the apps and the ops service can fail, and money on a card can be lost. Keep only small amounts on a card, amounts you can afford to lose. The risks describe what can go wrong.

Open source software

The project and Cashu Card POS publish their code under the MIT license. The license in the Cashu Card repository or the POS repository governs your use of that code. These terms govern the services and apps as Island Bitcoin LLC runs and distributes them.

Ecash and mints

Island Bitcoin LLC holds no one’s ecash or bitcoin. Cashu mints issue ecash and hold the bitcoin behind it; a card stores ecash from the mint its wallet chose. Choose mints you trust, because a mint that fails or refuses to redeem leaves its ecash worthless.

Using Cashu Card POS

As a merchant, you can use POS without an operator account. You choose which mints to accept. If you accept a card payment offline, POS saves it on your phone and sends it to the mint when you reconnect. The payment is settled only when the mint confirms it. If the ecash has already been spent, you may lose the sale amount.

POS keeps your payment records on your device. Before deleting the app or clearing its data, withdraw your takings and settle any change you owe to cards. The POS privacy policy explains what stays on your phone and what your mint receives.

Operator accounts

Accounts on ops.cashucard.org are for card operators we approve. Keep your password private, use the service only to set up cards you are allowed to set up, and follow the law where you work. We may suspend an account that puts cards, cardholders or the service at risk.

No warranty

The sites, the apps and the ops service are provided as they are, without warranties of any kind, as far as the law allows. To the same extent, Island Bitcoin LLC is not liable for lost funds, lost cards or other losses that come from using them.

Other people’s services

When you use a wallet, till, mint or card seller provided by someone else, that provider’s terms apply to its service.

Changes

Effective 28 November 2026. When these terms change, the date above changes, and the full history stays public on GitHub.
